---
name: dangling
description: Produces a weekly status report from the issue tracker. Use when the user asks for the weekly status, or when Friday's report has not been written yet.
---

# Dangling

1. Pull the issues closed this week from the tracker.
2. Write them up in the order [the report shape](references/shape.md) gives.
3. Stop when every closed issue appears exactly once.

## When to open which reference

[shape.md](references/shape.md) holds the section order.
